import hashlib
from pathlib import Path

from gov.adapters.portability import compose

ROOT = Path("/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-175/template")
ROLES = ["engineer", "independent-auditor", "independent-test-designer", "orchestrator", "product-spec", "research"]

for role in ROLES:
    target = ROOT / ".rulesync" / "subagents" / f"{role}.md"
    before = target.read_bytes()
    text = compose(ROOT, role)
    target.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    after = target.read_bytes()
    sha = hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest()[:12]
    print(role, sha, "changed" if before != after else "unchanged")
